gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hedvig-letters-san: Joystix is arcade-bold, tracked wide, its stems barely heavier than the arms. Hedvig Letters Sans does the friendly talking, with a generous gap in its c and small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-heebo: Wide-tracked, arcade-loud lettering defines Joystix, stems barely thicker than its arms. Heebo, with its tall central band, can sit a touch smaller and stay perfectly readable without any fuss.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hind-guntur: Bold, widely tracked Joystix leads with stems barely heavier than its arms. Hind Guntur runs in a single cable-like line weight with tall stamped-metal lowercase, giving Joystix's loud heading a body that never fights it.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hind-madurai: Widely tracked arcade letters, with thins that never turn spindly, make Joystix loud without getting brittle. Hind Madurai's ribbon-cut sans never swells, keeping all that loudness in check.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hind-mysuru: Joystix is all arcade swagger, gradually weighted and widely spaced. Hind Mysuru reads steadily over a long text, its single-depth strokes and ajar a shapes keeping lowercase tops close to ascender height.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hind-siliguri: Arcade-loud and widely tracked, Joystix gets its punch from thin strokes of respectable weight and stems barely heavier than their arms. Hind Siliguri, a sans-serif, hums along in constant, stout lines.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara reads clean and spacious, with open terminals and tall-bowled e and a. And Joystix, arcade-bold and widely tracked, can go big while the body text stays modest.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-huninn: Loud, arcade, widely spaced: Joystix grins with in-between stroke contrast and stems barely heavier than their arms. Huninn settles into the text, every stroke cut to a single width.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-inter-tight: Widely tracked arcade lettering gives Joystix its loud streak, with only a gentle swing between heavy and light strokes. Inter Tight draws a rope-like line, uniform end to end, and that is what steadies the pair.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-karla: Wide tracking and moderate contrast give Joystix its arcade punch. Karla sits beneath it with a gaping c and a tall middle band, so the loud heading and friendly body share one page.
